title: RFI: USDA Office of the Chief Financial Officer (OCFO) Invoice Processing Platform
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.USDA, DEPARTMENTAL ADMINISTRATION.USDA, OCP-POD-ACQ-MGMT-BRANCH-FTC
description_text: This is a Request for Information (RFI) only. The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Office of the Chief Financial Officer (OCFO) is seeking input on an Integrated Utilities and Telecommunications Expense Management (UTEM) and Invoice processing Managed Services platform. See Attachment 1 - RFI for more information and responses instructions.
